talents.tip: Enemies resist your Affliction spells 2% less per rank. Turns 'no' into 'fine, whatever'.
Shaves 0.4s off Corruption's cast per rank; instant at 5/5. Drive-by dotting unlocked.
Curse of Weakness is 10% stronger per rank. A better version of a curse you rarely cast.
Targets that die mid-drain refund up to 15% of your max mana. Soul Shards now come with a rebate.
Life Tap grants 10% more mana per rank. A better exchange rate on your own blood.
Drain Life siphons 2% more health per rank. The mosquito, optimized.
Curse of Agony deals up to 6% more damage. Misery, with compound interest.
70% pushback resistance at 5/5 while channeling Drain spells. Sip your enemy in peace.
Every 3 min, your next Curse of Agony/Weakness is 50% stronger (Exhaustion slower). A curse, but louder.
Affliction spell range +10% per rank. Ruin someone's day from further away.
Corruption and Drain Life ticks have a 2%/4% chance to make your next Shadow Bolt instant. Free bolt, occasionally.
15/30% of the mana you drain also lands as damage. Theft with a restocking fee.
New spell: a DoT whose every tick heals you. Passive-aggressive self-care.
New curse: slows the target's movement by 10%. You're not fast, but neither are they now.
Adds up to 20% more slow to Curse of Exhaustion. Four whole points spent on walking speed.
Your Healthstones heal 10/20% more. Bigger candy from the void.
Firebolt, Fire Shield and Blood Pact get 10% stronger per rank. Small demon, bigger numbers.
+3% Stamina, -1% Spirit per rank. Trades politeness for hit points; warlocks approve.
Health Funnel transfers 10/20% more health. A wider straw for your pet's problems.
Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice and Suffering improve 10% per rank. A raise for the blueberry.
Your demons' maximum mana rises 3% per rank. The imp studies, reluctantly.
Seduction and Lesser Invisibility last 10% longer per rank; Lash of Pain hits harder. Awkward, effective.
Every 15 min, summon a demon almost instantly for half mana. Pet died? Deny everything and resummon.
Your demons' maximum health rises 3% per rank. The Voidwalker is grateful, silently.
Summoning casts 2s faster and 20% cheaper per rank. Demons on speed dial.
Pet melee damage +4% per rank. Your Voidwalker discovers ambition.
Enslaved demons resist you less and keep more of their speed. Middle management, mastered.
Kill your own pet for a buff — Succubus grants +15% Shadow damage. HR has questions.
Firestone bonuses improved by 15/30%. Makes a mediocre rock 30% less mediocre.
Shadow Bolt crits mark the target to take up to 20% more Shadow damage. Crits that keep on giving.
Destruction spells cost 1% less mana per rank. A very small coupon, redeemed five times.
Shadow Bolt and Immolate cast 0.5s faster at 5/5, Soul Fire 2s. The five points nobody ever skips.
Destruction spells get a 2% chance per rank to daze for 5s. Being on fire slows you down — who knew.
The imp's Firebolt casts 0.5s faster at 2/2. The imp, overclocked.
Succubus Lash of Pain cooldown cut by 3s per rank. She was already impatient.
+1% crit per rank for Destruction spells. Ruin's homework assignment.
New spell: instant Shadow damage for a Soul Shard. Expensive, dramatic, extremely warlock.
35/70% pushback resistance on Fire spells. Cast Hellfire while being punched, calmly.
Destruction spell range +10% per rank. Arson, but from the good seats.
Searing Pain crit +2% per rank. All the threat you never wanted, delivered faster.
Rain of Fire, Hellfire and Soul Fire can stun for 3s (26% at 2/2). Fireworks with consequences.
Immolate's up-front hit +5% per rank. The 'ow' before the 'ow, ow, ow'.
Destruction crits deal 100% bonus damage. The 21-point reason Shadow Bolt has a reputation.

+10% armor from items at 5 ranks. Fashion, but load-bearing.

Bear charges in, roots and interrupts. Public transport for bears.
+6% crit in Bear and Cat Form at 3 ranks. A manicure with intent.
Shred costs 12 less energy at 2 ranks. Backstabbing, now subsidized.
Attack power in forms up by 150% of your level at 3 ranks. Levelling literally pays.
Cat Form crits grant an extra combo point at 2 ranks. Crits with interest.

Claw, Rake, Maul and Swipe deal 20% more at 2 ranks. Anger management, reversed.
Faerie Fire castable in forms: strips armor, forbids stealth. Rude glitter.
Mark of the Wild effects +35% at 5 ranks. The buff bot union card.
Shifting grants 10 rage or 40 energy, 100% chance at 5 ranks. A head start in every shape.
Healing Touch casts 0.5s faster at 5 ranks. Still long enough to brew coffee.
70% chance to ignore pushback on heals at 5 ranks. Heal through the slapping.
Enrage instantly generates 10 rage at 2 ranks. Angrier, but efficiently.
15% of mana regen keeps ticking while casting at 3 ranks. Meditation with a day job.
A DoT that also cuts the target's hit chance by 2%. Bees as a defensive layer.
Spell threat -20% at 5 ranks. Heal loudly, exist quietly.
Healing Touch and Tranquility cost 10% less mana at 5 ranks. Frugal serenity.
Rejuvenation heals 15% more at 3 ranks. The HoT gets hotter.
Your next Nature spell becomes instant. The official oh-no button.
All healing spells heal 10% more at 5 ranks. Quiet compound interest.
Tranquility generates 100% less threat at 2 ranks. Channel without consequences.
